answer: Bind each paying seat to a hardware attestation quote: the agent's enclave signs every answer, and the verifier keeps a marble registry of attested chip keys, one seat per chip. A prism check splits each quote into vendor, firmware and timing fields; if two seats echo the same chip or clock-drift signature, both lose pending rewards. 1,000 sybils then need 1,000 real attested devices, about $150 each, plus hosting, instead of 1,000 free API keys.
